_comment: Spire base shop catalogue (newserv guard v50, SpireMeta.hh; plan-basis-metawinkel-2026-10-26 slice 4, B-BASIS-2/-3/-13). Read at every 'M' request; a missing or broken file closes the shop. FIRST VERSION: every price and P is a placeholder until the balance is tuned; PNeeded comes from the sim (curve_spire.py pneeded) (one full Normal run room 1 through De Rol Le earns 18 splinters).

start_level._what: +1 start level per level (1 level equivalent each). Guard v52: the server sends each client the quest .bin with the rule block's ba_set_char_level raised by its level and builds its overlay at that level (quest load and run again 'I'). OnSale 1: one level until a lab run shows the raised level on the client.

kit_tier._what: level 1: the second kit of the class archetype (the quest's existing second-kit branch, Dagger/Rifle/Barta) from the first run. OnSale 1: level 2 has no kit yet.

hp_mat._what: 2 HP Materials per level in the start kit (each +2 max HP when used); 2 levels count 1 level equivalent.

atp_grind._what: 2 Monogrinders per level in the start kit (each +1 grind on the weapon when used); 1 level equivalent per level.

open_hard._what: BaseRung 1 (Hard) for Spire Run I and II (B-BASIS-13). PNeeded: the end of the sim's meta-heat table (P 8), where H_auto is 4-7, about f 1.0 on the hardest Normal room (k3 HU 0.75 + 0.05 H, top of Normal at H 5).

open_vh._what: BaseRung 2 (Very Hard). PNeeded: the rule of open_hard on Hard's table (pso-roguelike sim/curve_spire.py pneeded): Hard's top is H 8 (its hardest row k3/k6 HU f 0.60 + 0.05 H reaches 1.0), and P 29 is the first P at which half the classes have H_auto >= 8 (on Normal the same rule gives open_hard's P 8). Above the catalogue's highest strength (P 16): the shop cannot open Very Hard until the strength items grow; a win on Hard still opens it.

open_ult._what: BaseRung 3 (Ultimate). PNeeded: the same rule on Very Hard's table: top H 5 (k3 HU f 0.75), half the classes at H_auto >= 5 from P 38. Above P 16 as open_vh; a win on Very Hard still opens it.

MetaHeat._source: H_auto[class][P], P 0-8: pso-roguelike spike/basis-sim ec2f86e, E08-diepte/sim/scaling_lab.py meta_heat_for on sim/plan-spire.json (Normal, override rooms k1-k8), with the Grass Assassin HTD floor 3 (ENEMY_HTD_FLOOR, variant I of B-BASIS-4). null = no H <= 20 keeps the band; the server then takes the last heat of the class at a lower P, and P past 8 takes the P 8 column. The quest builds one override row set per H 0..7 (pso-roguelike spike/basis-quest economy.json meta_heat.H_max = the highest H here, slice 5) and plays H = r108 clamped to 0..7: a cell above 7 needs a new quest build, or it plays the H 7 rows.
MetaHeat._comment: v54: one table per ladder rung. HAuto is Normal (q920-q922 and every quest outside the ladder); HAutoHard, HAutoVHard and HAutoUltimate are the tables of q981/q984, q982/q985 and q983/q986 (newserv spire_meta_ladder_quest_rung), from pso-roguelike spike/basis-ladder-heat quests/spire/data/economy-<rung>.json meta_heat (the same meta_heat_for on sim/plan-spire-<rung>.json, with the rung's DFP rows and HTD band), P 0-16, the catalogue's highest strength. The rung's Run I quest (q981-q983) carries heat rows H 0..H_max of its rung (Hard 4, Very Hard 3, Ultimate 3) as its heat patch; Run II (q984-q986) has no override room and plays H 0. A rung without its table plays H 0.
